rootCause: Fixed positioning can be attached to a scroll container or a different ancestor/viewport. Old paths unconditionally anchored direct fixed children, and transforms added to normal-flow wrappers introduced new fixed containing blocks. Existing transformed-fixed tests incorrectly expected blue where independent native source screenshots are green.
method: 27 shared fixtures with exact native source screenshot and capture RGBA controls in each of Chromium, Firefox and WebKit; source DOM and scroll immutability. Final baseline restores only clone-scroll.ts from 7169372 without changing fixtures or browser commands.
